scope: Read-only refresh of the current guest framebuffer to see whether the historical comparison target became visible since R461.
method: Confirmed the channel had no pending request, ran a read-only MAME screen snapshot and read-only probe, then confirmed no pending request after completion. No key, mouse, focus, guest file, VM setting, or process was changed.
result: The current snapshot is byte-identical to R461: all guest framebuffer pixels remain black while the Apollo command strip is visible. This does not contradict the earlier successful wake; it records the current frame only. The separate Prancheta MAME remains active, so verify.sh blocks guest input.
next: Keep I167 active and continue only when a non-duplicative GTK2 task becomes available or the separate MAME releases the guard. Then revalidate identity, wake once if required, and resume the native scrollbar-state comparison.
